cases.purpose: Family lookup completes, zero-state peer uses singular keepalive, and an absent device fails.
cases.oracle: Fresh mapped user+network namespace with a kernel WireGuard device (ip link add wg0 type wireguard). Kernel state is read back (and for show seeded) with an independent generic-netlink codec written from linux/wireguard.h; public keys are checked against the RFC 7748 section 6.1 X25519 vectors; show text is compared with the wg(8) contract. Per-check detail in stderr of the raw record.
cases.comparison: Contract: candidate-only run; per-check detail retained in stderr of the raw record, stdout carries the verdict.
